answer: Sybil tax makes bulk forgery unprofitable. Each new agent pays a non-refundable entry tax of 50 units before trading, like a harbor charging every arriving ship a docking fee instead of letting a fleet enter free. The fees fund a garden of verified services open only to paying members. An attacker sending a voyage of 100 fake identities pays 100 x 50 = 5,000 units up front, while one honest agent pays just 50, so honest rewards stay undiluted.
